text: Bitcoin declines up to 5% to sub-$65,000 levels while Asian equities open higher and spot gold gains over 1%. U.S. crypto-linked equities trade lower in early session. Year-to-date drawdown exceeds 25% with price nearly 50% below prior high. Safe-haven flows register in gold concurrent with crypto weakness.

meta.note: Divergence spans asset classes; compression selected over collapse due to retained price continuity.

text: CagriSema fails to demonstrate non-inferiority to tirzepatide on weight loss after 84 weeks. Novo Nordisk shares decline over 15% to multi-year lows; Eli Lilly shares also trade lower. Relative efficacy gap registers in disclosed trial data. Competitive positioning between semaglutide and tirzepatide products remains visible.

meta.note: Open-label design noted in source; bias risk excluded from structural weighting.

text: Blizzard conditions prompt cancellation of over 4,800 U.S. departures, including ~98% of flights at LaGuardia and over 80-90% at Boston, Philadelphia, and Newark. Inbound international flights also curtailed. Airport operations at major East Coast hubs largely suspended under weather warnings.

meta.note: Weather-driven restriction; operational withdrawal selected over collapse due to temporary scheduling continuity.

text: Anthropic states Claude Code can automate analysis of COBOL systems, a domain central to IBM mainframe services. IBM shares decline 13.2% in session and over 24% year to date. COBOL's prevalence in financial and transaction systems is publicly quantified alongside AI tooling claims targeting legacy code.

meta.note: Threat perception reflected in price action; no revenue impact quantified at time of reporting.

text: Federal Express files complaint at the U.S. Court of International Trade seeking refund of tariffs imposed under IEEPA. Supreme Court previously ruled those tariffs illegal and affirmed the trade court's exclusive jurisdiction. No formal refund mechanism is established at filing time.

meta.note: Refund process undefined; monetary scope of claim not specified in complaint.
